events.title: Haudenosaunee assistance
events.text: The expedition acts under its own alliance agreements. Cook offers cooperation with the Commonwealth. At capacity, an officer enters reserve and replacements substitute for an extra regiment.

choices.label: Welcome Cook and the War Party
choices.description: Unlock War Parties; Cook joins with a detachment if capacity permits.

choices.label: Request a liaison officer
choices.description: Cook joins reserve; unlock War Party recruitment without adding a regiment.

events.title: The British expedition arrives
events.text: Despard’s expedition reaches the Commonwealth. The line detachment enters the Vistula battlefield after sixty simulated seconds.

choices.label: Accept Despard and line infantry
choices.description: Unlock British troops; add an expeditionary regiment if space permits.

choices.label: Accept Despard and rifle specialists
choices.description: Unlock British troops; add a rifle detachment if space permits.

events.title: A Dangerous Choice
events.text: Russian pressure leaves time for one operation. These alternatives replace each other; the campaign still has six battles.

choices.label: Rescue the allied force
choices.description: Success adds friendly support in The Two Eagles.

choices.label: Intercept the supply column
choices.description: Success removes one Russian assault battalion in The Two Eagles.

events.title: Political tensions
events.text: Regular officers and republican organisers seek support. Choose a clearly defined reinforcement; at capacity it becomes replacements.

choices.label: Support republican volunteers
choices.description: Add Scythemen (or replacements at capacity); endorse citizen formations.

choices.label: Support regular officers
choices.description: Add regular infantry (or replacements at capacity); preserve conventional organisation.

events.title: Commonwealth volunteers assemble
events.text: Warsaw sends its remaining volunteers to the army.

choices.label: Accept citizen militia
choices.description: Add militia, or restore 35% of missing soldiers at capacity.

choices.label: Accept Scythemen
choices.description: Add Scythemen, or restore 35% of missing soldiers at capacity.

events.title: Prussian–Russian disagreement
events.text: Enemy liaison officers have quarrelled. Exploit the delay or give the army time to recover.

choices.label: Disrupt their liaison
choices.description: Delay the Russian second wave in The Two Eagles by 45 seconds.

encounters.title: The Frontier
encounters.briefing: Kościuszko orders your detachment to repel the Prussian advance. Keep your firing line together and preserve the citizen formations.
encounters.knownEnemy: Bülow: three infantry battalions and a cavalry detachment.

objectives.description: Drive off the Prussian advance force.

encounters.title: The Forest Road
encounters.briefing: Joseph Louis Cook and the allied detachment join the defence of a wooded road. Stop the column reaching the western exit for six minutes; forcing its army to break also succeeds.
encounters.knownEnemy: A Prussian marching column with cavalry support.

objectives.description: Deny the western road exit for 360 seconds.

encounters.title: Defence of the Vistula
encounters.briefing: Hold the eastern bank for eight minutes. Despard’s expedition arrives after one minute. Enemy battalions have authored bridge and ford approach orders; all must cross physically.
encounters.knownEnemy: Blücher leads infantry and cavalry supported by a battery and a second wave.

objectives.description: Prevent an uncontested eastern bridgehead for 480 seconds.

encounters.title: A Dangerous Choice — Rescue
encounters.briefing: An allied detachment is cut off. Preserve at least half its original soldiers and bring them into the western withdrawal zone. The detachment follows an authored withdrawal route; you may redirect it.

objectives.description: Bring 50% of the allied detachment to the western safety area.

encounters.title: A Dangerous Choice — Interception
encounters.briefing: Intercept both supply trains before either reaches the eastern exit. Unarmed wagon proxies are physical, vulnerable regiment targets, not abstract cargo counters.
encounters.knownEnemy: Platov’s Cossacks and two escort battalions.

objectives.description: Disable both supply trains before one escapes.

encounters.title: The Two Eagles
encounters.briefing: Prussia and Russia converge. Hold the road junction for nine minutes or break the offensive. The rescue provides an allied support battalion; severed supplies remove one Russian assault battalion.
encounters.knownEnemy: Blücher, Bagration and Platov coordinate a mixed offensive.

objectives.description: Deny the western road junction for 540 seconds.

encounters.title: The Road to Warsaw
encounters.briefing: Suvorov attempts one last decisive assault. Defend the Warsaw road for ten minutes or break his force. A final victory with at least 55% surviving roster strength is decisive; otherwise peace is negotiated.
encounters.knownEnemy: Suvorov: a major infantry assault, cavalry exploitation and artillery support.

objectives.description: Protect the Warsaw approach for 600 seconds or break the invasion.
